description: Indexing an unknown list with -1 gives an unknown element
notes: The spec says a list key must be a non-negative integer and that a key outside the range of elements is an error, and -1 is outside the range of every list. It also says that when the collection is an unknown value of a suitable type the result is an unknown value, which supports hashicorp/hcl: go-cty's HasIndex reports unknown for an unknown list before looking at the key (Index in ops.go, Value.HasIndex in cty/value_ops.go).
